'''Doc Drase''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] that worked on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Cloud Cover!" />

She was secretly a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and aided the Cloud City cell led by [[Card Captor]]. It was suggested she did this out of revenge for the destruction of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Cloud Cover!" />
